title: Ribbed progress bar illusion reducing perceived waiting time by 11%
statement:
Adding backwards-moving, decelerating ribbed patterns to a progress bar creates a visual illusion that reduces perceived waiting time by up to 11%.

Options:
- Faster Perceived Time: Backward-moving ripples with deceleration (fits: long wait times, heavy processing)
- Neutral Baseline: Solid, smooth fill (fits: short wait times, standard ui)
- Unknown Duration: Indeterminate looping spinner (fits: network requests, unpredictable loads)
appliesWhen: Applies to: file uploads, system processes, loading screens. Audience: general.

source.title: Rethinking the progress bar
source.authors: Chris Harrison; Brian Amento; Stacey Kuznetsov; Robert Bell
source.venue: Proceedings of the 20th annual ACM symposium on User interface software and technology (UIST '07)
